narr: Abundant monsoon moisture remained in place across the Western Slope. As a result, another round of widespread showers and thunderstorms developed across the area with many storms producing heavy rain. This led to localized flash flooding and debris flows across portions of Mesa, Ouray and Gunnison counties.
ev: Mesa County Sheriff's Office responded to a report of two hikers trapped by flash flood waters in Rough Canyon. When deputies arrived at the trailhead, it was discovered several other people were also unable to reach the parking lot due to rising floodwaters. Storms in the area quickly turned what typically is a dried creek bed at the start of the trail into an unpassable rushing river. Rescue crews estimate it was about 15 feet wide and 3-5 feet deep. It took about 6 hours for the water to recede enough for rescuers to reach everyone. Four families, who started the day on a hike or UTV trail, were safely rescued.
